findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:581 planned_path_authority_bypass: authorization inspects only the incoming verificationIntent. In PLAN, an ordinary main-agent can replace an existing verificationIntent containing plannedPathDeclarations with an otherwise identical intent that omits them; checklist_update succeeds and erases the frozen canonical declaration. Targeted handler probe observed outcome=verificationIntent updated, changed=true, plannedRemaining=false. Guard old and new values under the checklist lock and reject any add/change/removal unless the dispatched verification-intent role owns the write; add an atomic removal mutation test.

packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:269 planned_endpoint_role_not_validated: planned source resolution checks only that endpointRef exists, so a topology producer may reference the declaration consumer endpoint while its consumer references the producer endpoint and receive zero diagnostics/result=inconclusive_basis_unverified. This violates verificationIntent ownership of endpoint roles and the promised producer/consumer role-mismatch diagnostic. Validate expected endpoint role at producerRefs/consumerRefs and add a swap mutation bite.
